evidenceRule: Links represent named organizations, brands, investments and dated source-backed relationships. A PE portfolio relationship is NOT identical to majority ownership; a business unit is NOT necessarily a separate legal entity. Do not join ZIP to specific local facility without validated outlet registry and geo boundaries.
pricingRule: No verified local price increase or politician-to-owner-to-household causal relation is established by the graph. Also include outcomes where ownership may increase supply, efficiency, affordability or quality, if evidenced.
